labels.text: section 5000A(c)(2)(B): the percentage of household income over the filing threshold

1.0 percent for taxable years beginning in 2014 — IRC_S5000A_NOTE_7 (taxable years ending after Dec. 31, 2013) and the pinned 2024 text; the years 2016-2018 carry different values in the text before Pub. L. 115-97 §11081, which the pinned 2024 edition does not contain — SOURCE_GAP
